title: Nobody Noticed Your Embarrassing Moment. Here's Proof

scenes.text: Nobody noticed your embarrassing moment. Science proved it.
At Cornell University, students had to walk into a room wearing a cringeworthy T-shirt.
Afterwards, they guessed about half the people in the room had noticed it.
The real number? Around a quarter.
Psychologists call this the spotlight effect. You feel watched because you're the center of your own world.
Everyone else is busy starring in theirs. So go ahead and wear the shirt.

description:
In a Cornell study, students wearing an embarrassing T-shirt guessed that about half the room noticed. Only about a quarter did.
It's called the spotlight effect: we massively overestimate how much others notice us.
What moment do you still cringe about?
